errors.text_span: The slices are colored red, light green, pink, blue, and light blue, respectively.
errors.evidence: The mapping of colors to the categories listed previously ("Very easy", "Easy", "Medium", "Hard", and "Very hard") is incorrect. For example, the description states "Very easy" is red, but in the chart it is light purple. It states "Very hard" is light blue, but in the chart it is orange/peach. The colors are not correctly assigned to their respective categories.

The description states the slices are arranged in descending order proceeding clockwise from "Medium". However, the arrangement is in descending order when proceeding counter-clockwise (Medium 51.8%, Hard 25.7%, Easy 11.2%, Very hard 6.5%, Very easy 4.7%). Following a clockwise direction breaks this descending order.
